description: An empty set with an unregistered alg foo fails with UnsupportedAlgorithm: the selector is validated before selection; decided by ADR 0054 §4 precedence: selector validation (2) comes before selection (3), so UnsupportedAlgorithm and not the NoMatchingKey of an empty set; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
